post.description: Replaces the API key: the previous one stops working at once. The new key is shown only in this response.
Public. Opens a new session (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie; Secure over HTTPS) and ends the one the browser presented. Failed attempts are throttled per address and per account: 429 with Retry-After.
Public. Ends the session of the cookie (if any) and clears the cookie.

put.description: Requires the current password. Ends every other session; a browser caller gets a fresh session cookie. With regenerateApiKey, the API key is replaced too (apps using the old one must be updated) and the new key is returned once.

delete.description: Signs a browser out. Ending the current session signs this browser out too.

post.description: Public while no account exists, 409 afterwards. Signs the caller in (session cookie) and returns the API key, shown only once. Password: 10 to 256 characters. Requires setupToken, the one-time token printed in the server logs, except from the server itself (loopback address and loopback Host): 403 when it is missing or wrong. 403 too when the Host header is not an IP address, localhost or an allowed host (GONEMA_ALLOWED_HOSTS).
post.summary: Create the admin account (first run only)

get.description: Public. setupRequired: no account yet. authenticated: the cookie, the API key or the local mode lets the caller in.

post.description: A consistent online copy (VACUUM INTO, writers are not blocked) zipped with a manifest (Gonema version, schema version, date). The master key file gonema.key is NOT included unless includeKey is true: such an archive unlocks every stored secret. 409 while another backup or restore runs.

post.description: Requires confirm=true. Validates the archive (manifest, checksum, integrity, schema version), backs up the current state first (kind pre-restore), then stages the database: it replaces the current one when Gonema restarts (202; restart Gonema to apply it). To restore a file from this computer, upload it first (POST /backups/upload).
